purpose: physical sanity check before the nine-plate project

print.material: any Bambu PLA Matte; colour is irrelevant
print.note: both parts print in the same orientation as the real ones

what_to_check: the arm snaps into the slot with about 1.2 N, one finger
push hard: the ledge stops it, the arm does not slide through
pull straight up: it releases at about 2.2 N with no tool
turn it over: the barb is visible in its recess and reachable
look at the clip beam's first layers: no droop, no weld to the tongue

geometry_checks.verified_on: the exported STLs, moved by rotations only

findings.detail: 5.3 mm² of downward faces steeper than 45° (0.3% of the part)
5.25 mm² reaches 1.50 mm beyond the layer below, anchored on 69% of its outline (a bridge, but a long one)
31.2 mm² of downward faces steeper than 45° (2.7% of the part)
17.15 mm² reaches 2.20 mm beyond the layer below, anchored on 51% of its outline (a bridge, but a long one)
